name: bestand
description: Bestand - sistema desktop de gerenciamento de estoque

scripts.dev:main: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && electron . --dev
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check-node: node -e "const v=process.versions.node; if(v!=='22.23.3'){console.error('Bestand exige Node.js 22.23.3. Detectado: '+v); process.exit(1)} console.log('Node.js 22.23.3 OK')"
scripts.package:linux: npm run verify && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
